claim: Human LON binds mtDNA promoter element
finding: Binds TG-rich LSP/HSP element only as single-stranded DNA, site- and strand-specific; E. coli Lon binds the duplex
confidence: high for binding; no site mapping on the protein

claim: Nucleic-acid binding is separable from catalysis
finding: ATP inhibits DNA/RNA binding; substrate raises affinity 3.5x; ATPase- and protease-dead Lon still binds nucleic acid
confidence: high; mutant is double-dead so it does not localise the site

claim: Binding is a defined interface, not a diffuse electrostatic sheath
finding: Enthalpy-driven binding to LSPas with large negative dCp; G-quartet-forming ssDNA specifically bound
confidence: high; argues for a localised, shape-selective site

claim: The Lon DNA site is in the AAA+ alpha subdomain
finding: Bt-Lon alpha subdomain binds DNA via R518, R557, R566; R557 also mediates allosteric coupling
confidence: high for Bt; transfer to human blocked by non-conservation

claim: Bacterial Lon alpha-domains bind duplex DNA
finding: Bt > Bs > Ec alpha-domain binding to the duplex ms1 sequence
confidence: high for bacteria; human binds ssDNA not duplex

claim: The inserted alpha-helical coiled-coil contributes to Lon-DNA complexes
finding: HI(CC) domain is dispensable for catalysis but affects ATPase/peptidase coupling and stability; proposed role in DNA complexes
confidence: moderate; the DNA role is a suggestion, not a measurement

finding: Abf2, Mgm101 and MrpL32 are protected from Lon when bound to nucleic acid; Twinkle is not
context: yeast and human proteins, in vitro digestion
confidence: high; the effect is substrate-side, not enzyme-side

claim: The strongest basic patch is outside the axial channel
finding: Largest positive patch 3,233 A2, +1.00 kT/e, NTD apex, r=22.6 A, z=+89.6 A; only in-channel patch is the protease product-exit face
context: screened-Coulomb electrostatics on the human hexamer
confidence: moderate; uniform-dielectric approximation, NTD at 3.8 A

finding: NTD apex 97.0% basic retention in vertebrates but only 20-45% in yeast/plant/bacterial Lon; AAA+ alpha cluster basic in every Lon tested
confidence: moderate; pairwise alignments, no structural alignment

finding: E. coli LonA net +6 with a 32,244 A2 positive band; human LONP1 (-0.096 kT/e) indistinguishable from archaeal LonB (-0.060) with no reported DNA binding
confidence: moderate; LonB absence of evidence is not evidence of absence

claim: R721 is a usable probe of the AAA+ alpha patch
finding: R721G causes CODAS syndrome with decreased ATP-dependent chaperone activity, so it is not a clean nucleic-acid-only probe
confidence: high; rules out R721 as a separation-of-function mutation
